subject: Draft: Evaluation playbook & MAP template for GreenWave pilot
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@greenwave.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya@greenwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft: Evaluation playbook & MAP template for GreenWave pilot

Hi Ethan / Priya —

Thanks again for the time this week. Per our conversation I pulled together a concise evaluation playbook and a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) seed doc so we can align on a tight pilot and acceptance path. The doc is editable — link below.

Quick summary:
- Two pilot options: compact 30-day technical sprint (fast validation) or 45–60 day pilot (integration + workload-driven validation).
- Core success metrics requested (we'll finalize): latency SLOs, token-cost targets, model-quality thresholds on your sample prompts, and throughput for peak windows.
- Next steps: please review the MAP GDoc and add any missing stakeholders / constraints. I included a starter slide deck for your execs.

Links & attachments:
- MAP seed (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GwMapTemplateStub
- Starter deck: initial-slide-deck.pptx (attached)
- Attachment: gw_map_template_v1.gdoc (Drive link)

Can you confirm whether you prefer the 30-day or 45–60 day flow? Also which day next week works for a 30–40 minute demo + kickoff (options: Tue 9/15 or Wed 9/16 afternoon PST).

If helpful, we'll include a brief security checklist and SOC-2 evidence summary in the MAP.

Thanks — looking forward.

—
Markus Klein
Lead, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@greenwave.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@greenwave.ai>
Date: 2026-09-09T14:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Evaluation playbook & MAP template for GreenWave pilot

Thanks Markus — this looks useful.

Quick responses:
- We like the 45-day sweet spot better (enough time to plug into our ingestion pipeline and run representative queries).
- Demo: Wed 9/16 at 2:00pm PT works for our team (Ethan + Priya + data infra lead).
- Security/compliance: please include a one-page checklist for data residency, log retention, and key management. We've attached our initial requirements doc (greenwave_requirements.pdf) for reference.

On success metrics, here's what matters most to us:
- End-to-end 95th pctl latency for inference < 500ms for single-request flows
- Cost guidance (expected price per 1M tokens for the pilot) — high level estimate is okay for now
- Quality: for reranking we need > 8.5 NDCG on our sample set (we can share the eval set once NDAs are confirmed)

Would be great if your MAP has clear owners and acceptance criteria per milestone. Priya flagged procurement timing as a blocker; a standard procurement checklist / templates will help accelerate.

Ethan

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Next steps for GreenWave MAP + owners

Team —

GreenWave picked the 45-day path and confirmed demo on Wed 9/16 at 2pm PT. Ethan sent a requirements PDF (attached). They emphasized: clear owners, security checklist, procurement templates, and acceptance criteria tied to NDCG/latency/cost.

Proposed MAP structure (GDoc sections):
1) Executive summary & target outcomes
2) Stakeholders & RACI (GreenWave + Redwood owners)
3) Success metrics (latency, cost, quality) — owner: Marissa
4) Test datasets & validation plan (dataset access, anonymization) — owner: Jasmine
5) Infra & networking checklist (VPC, KMS, data residency) — we own the checklist and attach SOC-2 evidence; owner: Ben
6) Timeline & milestones (kickoff, midpilot review, handoff to CS)
7) Acceptance matrix & sign-off (specific pass/fail criteria per milestone)
8) Procurement + DocuSign path (template + lead times)

Action items:
- Marissa: draft the success metrics table and populate expected targets (due: Mon 9/14)
- Jasmine: prepare a short test-plan doc listing required datasets and data access method; include anonymization notes (due: Mon 9/14)
- Ben: pull together the procurement checklist and SOC-2 evidence pointer; estimate procurement lead time and pricing for the 45-day pilot (due: Tue 9/15 morning)
- I'll finalize the MAP doc and share the editable GDoc with GreenWave after your inputs (goal: send the MAP by EOD Tue 9/15).

Links & attachments for the thread: gw_map_template_v1.gdoc (Drive link), initial-slide-deck.pptx (attached), greenwave_requirements.pdf (from Ethan). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/GW-9831

If any timing here is hard, call it out and I'll adjust. We'll also include a one-pager security checklist in the MAP for their initial review.

Thanks — Markus
